rule_level_problems.problem: 'Differs from surrounding moles' is absent from both the priority rule's OR and the mole check task; one of six red-box triggers is lost.

OR of four single lesion types: a lone Skin nodule or Pustule yields probable acne, so a KS lump, cyst or boil pustule also gives 'acne likely'. Page describes a mixed eruption, usually on the face; needs at least combined lesion types or a site constraint.

rule_level_problems.problem: Six-way AND requires Skin discharge to already be present; the page's 'softens in the centre to discharge pus' describes the course, so a red, warm, firm/fluctuant lump not yet discharging gets no diagnosis.

Task triggers only on Mass of skin / Mass of subcutaneous tissue, but the papule/pustule/comedone findings used by the wart, molluscum and acne rules are asked only inside it; a patient recorded with papules or spots rather than a 'mass' may never be asked those items.

summary: The red box loses 'Differs from surrounding moles': it isn't in the Urgent mole rule or in its check list. The acne rule is an OR of single lesions, so a lone nodule or pustule from any other branch gives probable acne. The boil/abscess rule needs discharge to be present already. Everything else on the page is encoded with existing SNOMED concepts. The remaining gaps are descriptors that have no concept (skin-coloured, pearly, moves easily).
